###### Smooth

Data dual-passed through a Butterworth filter (2nd order, 8Hz cutoff)

```{R}
filt_order <- 2
samp <- 120
cutoff <- 12
nyq <- samp / 2
Wn <- cutoff / nyq

butt <- butter(
  n = filt_order, w = Wn, type = "low", output = "Sos"
)

to_smooth <- grep("_x$|_y$|_z$", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)

for (col in to_smooth) {
  new <- paste0(col, "_smooth")

  dt[
    ,
    (new) := gsignal::filtfilt(butt, get(col)),
    by = .(participant_id, trial_num, block_num)
  ]
}
```

Filter cutoff (will be eventually) determined via visual inspection of raw and smoothed trajectories

###### Plotting functions
```{R}
# from supplied trial data, plots markers' positions about desired axis
# smoothed data is plotted when true
# geom sets whether geom_line or geom_smooth is drawn for each marker
plot_trial <- function(trial, axis, smoothed = FALSE) {
  # base plot
  p <- ggplot(trial, aes(x = frame))

  # add lines for desired markers
  for (i in 1:5) {
    col <- paste0("m", i, "_", axis)

    if (smoothed) col <- paste0(col, "_smooth")

    p <- p + geom_line(aes(y = get(col)), colour = palette[i])
  }

  # make context specific labels
  ylab <- paste0(axis, "-pos")

  if (smoothed) {
    ylab <- paste0(ylab, " (smoothed)")
  } else {
    ylab <- paste0(ylab, " (raw)")
  }

  p <- p + labs(x = "frame", y = ylab)

  # find extremes to use as axis limits
  limits <- trial[
    ,
    .(
      lower = unlist(min(.SD)),
      upper = unlist(max(.SD))
    ),
    .SDcols = patterns(paste0("_", axis))
  ]

  p <- p + ylim(c(limits$lower, limits$upper))


  return(p)
}

# conditionally extract trial data and pass to marker_plot()
# plot returned, not drawn
plot_trial <- function(dt, pid, trial, block, axis, smoothed = FALSE) {
  # get_trial() defined in utilities/functions.r
  get_trial(pid, trial, block) |> plot_trial(trial = _, axis, smoothed)
}
```

###### Plot raw vs smooth

```{R}
# short-hand
trial_props <- list(
  dt = dt,
  pid = unique(dt$participant_id)[3],
  trial = 1,
  block = 2,
  axis = NA,
  smoothed = FALSE,
  geom = "line"
)

# create plot of raw data for each axis
for (axis in c("x", "y", "z")) {
  # set axis
  trial_props$axis <- axis
  assign(
    # variable name plot will be stored under
    x = paste0("p", axis, "_raw"),
    value = do.call(plot_trial, trial_props)
  )
}

# same, but smoothed data
trial_props$smoothed <- TRUE

for (axis in c("x", "y", "z")) {
  trial_props$axis <- axis
  assign(
    x = paste0("p", axis, "_smooth"),
    value = do.call(plot_trial, trial_props)
  )
}

# create plot composite
require(patchwork)

raw_patch <- px_raw + py_raw + pz_raw

smooth_patch <- px_smooth + py_smooth + pz_smooth

patched <- raw_patch / smooth_patch
```

###### Drop raw data

```{R}
raw_cols <- grep("_x$|_y$|_z$", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)
dt[, (raw_cols) := NULL]

# drop _smooth from column names while we're here
colnames(dt) <- gsub("_smooth", "", colnames(dt))
```

###### Translate

Initial positions set as origin points

```{R}
mrk_cols <- grep("_x$|_y$|_z$", colnames(dt))

dt[
  ,
  (mrk_cols) := lapply(.SD, \(col) col <- col - col[1]),
  by = .(participant_id, trial_num, block_num),
  .SDcols = mrk_cols
]
```

###### Get hand position

Five markers used to track hand, (for now) treating the avg to represent hand pos

```{r}
lapply(
  c("x", "y", "z"),
  \(axis) {
    cols <- grep(paste0("_", axis, "$"), colnames(dt), value = TRUE)
    dt[, paste0("hand_", axis) := rowMeans(.SD), .SDcols = cols]
  }
)
```
